papers.title: Effects of Defocus Distance and Weld Spacing on Microstructure and Properties of Femtosecond Laser Welded Quartz Glass-TC4 Alloy Joints with Residual Stress Analysis
papers.abstract: This study develops an optimized femtosecond laser welding process for joining quartz glass and TC4 titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V) under non-optical contact conditions, specifically addressing the manufacturing needs of specialized photoelectric effect research containers. The joint primarily consists of parallel laser-welded zones (WZ) interspersed with base material. The defocus distance of the femtosecond laser predominantly influences the depth and phase composition of the WZ, while the weld spacing influences the crack distribution in the joint region. The maximum shear strength of 14.4 MPa was achieved at a defocusing distance of +0.1 mm (below the interface) and a weld spacing of 40 μm. The XRD stress measurements indicate that the defocusing distance mainly affects the stress along the direction of laser impact (DLI), whereas the weld spacing primarily influences the stress along the direction of spacing (DS). GPA results demonstrate that when the spacing is less than 30 μm, the non-uniform shrinkage inside the WZ induces tensile stress in the joint, leading to significant fluctuations in DS residual stress and consequently affecting the joint's shear strength. This study investigates the effects of process parameters on the mechanical properties of dissimilar joints and, for the first time, analyzes the relationship between joint residual strain and femtosecond laser weld spacing, providing valuable insights for optimizing femtosecond laser welding processes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究飞秒激光焊接石英玻璃与TC4合金，不属于增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学与疲劳性能范畴。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on femtosecond laser welding of quartz glass to TC4 alloy, not on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V mechanical or fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对石英玻璃与TC4合金的飞秒激光焊接工艺优化需求，研究离焦量和焊道间距对焊接质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变离焦量和焊道间距进行飞秒激光焊接实验，利用XRD和GPA分析残余应力与应变。
summary_zh.result: 离焦量+0.1 mm、焊道间距40 μm时获得最大剪切强度14.4 MPa，焊道间距影响残余应力波动。
summary_zh.validation: 剪切强度测试及XRD残余应力测量验证工艺参数效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize femtosecond laser welding of quartz glass to TC4 alloy for specialized photoelectric effect containers by investigating defocus distance and weld spacing effects.
summary_en.method: Femtosecond laser welding experiments with varying defocus distance and weld spacing were conducted, and residual stress was analyzed using XRD and GPA.
summary_en.result: A maximum shear strength of 14.4 MPa was achieved at +0.1 mm defocus and 40 μm spacing, with weld spacing significantly affecting residual stress fluctuations.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through shear strength tests and XRD residual stress measurements.
